'''Indo Zal's mother''' was a decorated [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] at the [[Battle of Scyva]]. She had two children, [[Indo Zal]] and [[Kalya Zal]] with her [[Indo Zal's father|partner]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Indo Zal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Indo Zal's mother is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in Indo Zal's Codex entry.
